news-korea-econ.title: Russia deploys North Korean missile unit to Ukraine; Moscow-Pyongyang axis deepens: report
news-korea-econ.description: A Ukrainian intelligence official says Russia is deploying a North Korean unit with up to 120 ballistic missiles in its war against Ukraine.

news-korea-econ.title: AMB GORDON SONDLAND: America's aid to Israel isn't charity — it's a bargain for US security
news-korea-econ.description: A former U.S. ambassador argues the $3.8 billion in annual security assistance to Israel yields unmatched returns in intelligence and missile defense.
